What I Know · Skills

Everything a website developer needs — I can do it

From the first line of code to going live: the full skill set behind every website I build, fix and launch for clients.

/ 01

HTML5

Clean, semantic page structure — the solid, accessible foundation of every site I build.

/ 02

CSS3

Modern layouts with Flexbox & Grid, animations and pixel-perfect styling in any brand's colours.

/ 03

JavaScript

The interactive layer — menus, carts, forms and live updates that work without page reloads.

/ 04

Responsive Design

Every site looks and works perfectly on phone, tablet and desktop — designed mobile-first, always.

/ 05

UI/UX Design

Clean layouts and clear user journeys that guide visitors straight to calling, booking or buying.

/ 06

API Integration (TMDB)

Live data pulled from external APIs — like movie data from TMDB — and displayed beautifully on-site.

/ 07

Search & Filter

Instant search and category filters so customers find a product or menu item in seconds, not minutes.

/ 08

Slider & Modal

Smooth image sliders, galleries, pop-up modals and quick-view windows that make browsing feel premium.

/ 09

Bug Fixing

I track down and fix broken layouts, dead buttons and failing forms — and explain what went wrong.

/ 10

Performance

Speed optimisation that keeps pages light and fast — even on slow mobile data and older phones.

/ 11

SEO Basics

Titles, meta tags and page structure set up properly so Google can find, understand and rank your site.

/ 12

Git / Deployment

Version control with Git and smooth deployment — your site goes live safely, with backups of every change.

Website Guide

What Bangladeshi businesses ask before ordering a website

Short, honest answers about website prices, delivery time and payment in Bangladesh — the same questions people type into Google every day.

It depends on the type: a landing page starts at ৳2,500, a full business website at ৳6,500, and an online shop at ৳9,000. You get a fixed written quote before any work starts — no hidden charges, no monthly fee.

A standard business website takes 3–5 days. A landing page takes 2–3 days and an online shop 5–7 days. You get a live preview link early, so you can follow the progress and ask for changes as we go.

Most customers in Bangladesh search on their phone first. A website shows your menu, services or courses, prices, opening hours and location on Google Maps — and lets customers book, order or message you on WhatsApp without calling. It makes a small business look professional and easy to reach.

A fast, mobile-first website: your services or menu, Google Map with opening hours and customer reviews, a contact form, and WhatsApp ordering or booking where it fits. Every site also comes with a simple written guide so you can change text, prices and photos yourself later.

In Bangladesh you can pay with bKash or Nagad. You pay 50% to start and the remaining 50% only when the finished site is live and you have approved it. International clients can pay with Payoneer or through Fiverr/Upwork.

Tap the green WhatsApp button on this page, or fill in the project inquiry form below — your message lands straight in my inbox. I reply within 24 hours with honest advice and a fixed quote, in Bangla or English.

Questions

Before you ask — the honest answers

A landing page takes 2–3 days, a standard business website 3–5 days, and an online shop 5–7 days. You'll get a live preview link early, so you can watch progress and request changes as we go — not just at the end.

In Bangladesh: bKash or Nagad. International clients: Payoneer or Fiverr/Upwork escrow. You pay 50% to start and the remaining 50% only when the finished site is live and you've approved it. No full payment upfront, ever.

Very little: your business name, what you sell, your prices, some photos (phone photos are fine) and your WhatsApp number. Don't have a logo or written content yet? I can help with both — just mention it in your message.

The website price is for design and build. A domain (your .com address) and hosting typically cost around ৳1,500–2,500 per year, paid directly to the provider in your own name — your site stays 100% yours. I'll set everything up for you and show you exactly what's what.

Yes. Every site includes a simple written guide (and a training video on shop plans) covering how to change text, prices and photos. And if you'd rather not touch it, small updates after launch start from just ৳300.

You approve the design from a live preview before the full build, and every package includes 2 rounds of revisions. If the first preview is completely off track, tell me before we proceed — I'd rather redesign early than hand over a site you don't love.
